# Ring of Feather Falling (`magic-items:ring-of-feather-falling`)
**Category:** [Rings](../equipment-categories/rings.md) | **Rarity:** Rare | **Attunement:** Yes

Ring

When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.
